result:
I've completed the visual optimization for all 14 slides. Here's a summary of the key changes:

**Chart Edits Summary:**

| Slide | Original Visual | Key Optimizations |
|-------|----------------|-------------------|
| SL01 | Complex 5-phase flowchart | Simplified to 2 phases + 1 gate with "YOU ARE HERE" marker |
| SL02 | 3-column diagram | 2 blocked columns with Nyx in the gap between them |
| SL03 | Detailed timeline | 3-point timeline (2025, 2027-2030, 2040) with window bracket |
| SL04 | Detailed table with 4 quadrants | 2x2 icon grid with headline metrics only |
| SL05 | Complex layered diagram | Clean L0/L1/L2 stack with dominant human oversight bar |
| SL06 | Multi-flow diagram | Simple 2-circle relationship diagram showing value flow to Soneium |
| SL07 | 4-dimension comparison table | 2-row comparison with ✓/✗ symbols only |
| SL08 | 4-row capability matrix | Simplified table showing Nyx+Sony as only complete option |
| SL09 | 3-layer control diagram | Inverted pyramid emphasizing human control at top |
| SL10 | Nested circles scope diagram | Clean IN/OUT split with strikethrough on excluded items |
| SL11 | Complex phased timeline | 5 growing phases with prominent exit gates |
| SL12 | 5-column risk table | 2-column Risk → Mitigation pairing |
| SL13 | Complex investment flow | Simple input (16M JPY) → 3 outputs diagram |
| SL14 | Action card with details | 3-item numbered checklist with checkboxes |

**Consistent Design Principles Applied:**
- Single intended takeaway per visual
- Maximum 2-3 data dimensions per chart
- Clear visual hierarchy with highlighting for key elements
- Removed gridlines, excess legends, and secondary metrics
- Added focus cues (arrows, labels, highlighting)
